title: Network Interference / SUTVA Violation: · Graph Cluster Randomization · Geo-Splitting
prompt: **Network Interference / SUTVA Violation:** You are testing a new feed algorithm on LinkedIn or dynamic pricing on Uber. Why does simple user-level randomization fail when Treatment and Control users interact in the same social graph or ride pool? Compare **Graph Cluster Randomization**, **Geo-Splitting**, and **Time-Based Switchback Testing**.
